test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Vipin can do a piece of work in 2 days; Vaibhav can do the same work in 3 days and Chirag can do the same work in 6 days. If they start working together, how many days will they take to complete the work?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Vipin can do a piece of work = 2 days

Vaibhav can do the same work = 3 days

Chirag can do the same work = 6 days

**CALCULATION:**

⇒Total work = LCM of 2 ,3 and 6 = 6

⇒Work efficiency of vipin = 6/2 = 3
